sourceTitle: The Inflexible Captive: A Tragedy, in Five Acts
description: "The Inflexible Captive: A Tragedy, in Five Acts" by Hannah More is a historical tragedy likely written in the early 19th century. The play centers around the character of Regulus, a Roman general who is taken captive during the First Punic War and faces the moral dilemma of returning to Carthage as a prisoner or violating his oath to his captors.
